Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Strategist role at your company. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I have developed a comprehensive skill set that aligns perfectly with the responsibilities outlined in your job description.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my ability to develop content strategies that drive organic growth. I conduct keyword research, create editorial calendars, and produce SEO-optimized blog content that resonates with target audiences. I am particularly drawn to your company's emphasis on creativity, curiosity, and strategic thinking. I thrive in environments where I can experiment, challenge assumptions, and contribute to meaningful projects. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your company's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · Content Strategy · Web

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content strategy. At Episto, I develop and execute content strategies, create editorial calendars, and produce SEO-optimized content that aligns with business goals. On my own project (mirook.com), I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Skilled in content management, analytics, and project management, with a passion for brand storytelling and strategic thinking. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Content Strategy & Marketing: editorial planning, content roadmaps, brand storytelling, SEO blog writing, content management systems (WordPress)
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
